_doc: Every line by key, read out of game/src/narrative/lines.gd by adapters/godot_lines_gd.py. Keys are stable; renaming one is a migration. The shape is the skill's templates/strings.json.

name.corp.note: The creditor. On the terminals, the augs, the Landlord's paperwork.

name.protagonist.note: The account holder — how the corp prints it.

name.defaulter.note: The dead defaulter in the Gut.

name.boss.note: The enforcer. A title, not a name — the Stacks never learned his.

bark.wake.text: Fourteen-C. Still mine, as long as the payments clear.
bark.wake.speaker: dani

bark.first_save.text: Their terminal. Their body. Every save is a receipt.
bark.first_save.speaker: dani

bark.mag_hook.text: A tower tech's mag-hook. He's not going to need it.
bark.mag_hook.speaker: dani

bark.cyberdeck.text: More room to run their programs. Or mine.
bark.cyberdeck.speaker: dani

bark.overload.text: Corporate property, pointed the other way.
bark.overload.speaker: dani

bark.breach.text: Every door in the Stacks answers to VESTA. Now one of them answers to me.
bark.breach.speaker: dani

bark.sidewinder.text: A Sidewinder unit, still sealed. Legs like these need surgery, not a screwdriver.
bark.sidewinder.speaker: dani

bark.sidewinder_installed.text: Stitch says it'll hold. Stitch says a lot of things.
bark.sidewinder_installed.speaker: dani

bark.chip.text: Ferro's chip. Whatever's on it, he'd rather die down here than let them take it.
bark.chip.speaker: dani

bark.pre_boss.text: He's got the override. I've got a wrench.
bark.pre_boss.speaker: dani

bark.post_boss.text: It's not forgiveness. It's the keys.
bark.post_boss.speaker: dani

marisol.offer.2.text: Ferro ran when Collections hit twelve. Took his chip and went down into the Gut.
marisol.offer.2.speaker: marisol

marisol.offer.3.text: He's dead down there. I know that. I want the chip back before they repossess what's left of him.
marisol.offer.3.speaker: marisol

marisol.offer.4.text: Bring it and you can have his hardhat. He'd have hated that. Take it anyway.
marisol.offer.4.speaker: marisol

marisol.active.text: The Gut. Past the pumps, below the lift. The water's live — VESTA never paid to ground it.
marisol.active.speaker: marisol

marisol.complete.2.text: The hat's yours. Don't die in it.
marisol.complete.2.speaker: marisol

marisol.after.text: Go on. The Landlord's got a floor to work, and it's ours.
marisol.after.speaker: marisol

stitch.greet.1.text: Stitch. Ripperdoc, pawn, whatever the day needs.
stitch.greet.1.speaker: stitch

stitch.greet.2.text: Credits only. VESTA stopped taking my calls.
stitch.greet.2.speaker: stitch

stitch.install.1.text: A Sidewinder. Sealed unit, corp stamp and all. Where'd you-- no. Don't tell me.
stitch.install.1.speaker: stitch

stitch.install.2.text: Lie down. This won't hurt. The anaesthetic's on your tab.
stitch.install.2.speaker: stitch

stitch.after_install.text: Legs feel wrong for a day. Then they feel like yours. That's the trick of it.
stitch.after_install.speaker: stitch

notice.care.text:
{name.corp} CARE TERMINAL
Restoration is a service. Services are billed.
